adapter.unit_conversion: Supports g, m/s^2, deg/s, rad/s, cm/mm/m, cm/s/km/h; defaults are explicitly recorded SI assumptions.
adapter.missing_values: Missing raw inputs are filled with the corresponding training normal-reference median and listed in mapping JSON.
adapter.applicability_rule: More than half of expected raw sensor columns missing means not applicable; do not score.
adapter.coordinate_frames: No frame rotation or vehicle-specific calibration is inferred.

security_telemetry_model.reason: External datasets do not provide this project?s ROS graph node hashes, publisher/subscriber counts, and telemetry counters; no proxy mapping is claimed.

transfer_caveat: Any future external metrics are transfer estimates, not proof of real-world performance.
true_test_requirements: recordings from an owned ROS 2 robot or vehicle
